# Gearbox Autos

> Gearbox Autos is a used-car marketplace and dealership in Sonari, Jamshedpur, connecting local buyers and sellers.

Gearbox Autos lists verified pre-owned cars, arranges test drives, assists with inspections and RC transfer, and helps owners sell cars in Jamshedpur and nearby areas.

## Buy a car

- [Used Cars in Jamshedpur](/used-cars-in-jamshedpur): Browse verified local second-hand cars and filter available stock by brand.
- [Buy a Used Car](/buy): Search current inventory by make, model, or fuel type.
- [Full Inventory](/inventory): View every active car listing.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): Understand test drives, owner meetings, negotiation, purchase, and RC transfer.

## Sell a car

- [Sell Your Car](/sell): Submit a car for valuation and follow-up.
- [Sell a Car in Jamshedpur](/sell-car-jamshedpur): Learn about local listing, verification, buyer meetings, and transfer support.

## Knowledge and business information

- [Gearbox Garage](/garage): Explore automotive buying, selling, comparison, and inspection guidance.
- [About Gearbox Autos](/about): Learn about the dealership's transparent marketplace approach.
- [Contact Gearbox Autos](/contact): Find the Sonari showroom address, phone number, email, and opening hours.
